description: The Khaite tidal earrings are crafted in Italy from gold-plated brass. These drop earrings feature a post-back fastening and include a dust bag and presentation box.

description: The FRAME Femme sweater features a mixed cable knit design, a crew neckline, and long sleeves. The hem sits at the hip. It has a relaxed fit and is a pullover style crafted from cotton, nylon, polyamide, and mohair.

name: Beige Drawstring Wide-Leg Jeans
description: Citizens of Humanity's 'Brynn' jeans feature a drawstring at the mid-rise waist. The jeans are crafted from soft denim and have wide legs. They are made using at least 50% lower-impact materials or ingredients.

name: Naida Belted Fringed Embroidered Cotton-voile And Lace Coverup
description: Inspired by her passion of worldly travel, Miguelina Gambaccini's namesake brand blends a "bohemian; free-spirited aesthetic with a nomadic sensibility". This belted 'Naida' coverup is made from embroidered cotton-voile and lace and trimmed with fringing, which will swish as you stroll along the beach.

name: Red & Pink Silk Floral Tie-neck Shirt
Miller Marilyn Ruched One-Piece Swimsuit
description: The Johnny Was "Marilyn" one-piece swimsuit features a Miller multi-pattern scarf print with tiger details, a face-framing square neckline, and adjustable straps. It has moderate seat coverage and is ruched. It is made of nylon, polyamide, and elastane. The lining is nylon and elastane.

name: Gray Cropped T-Shirt
description: This Éterne 'Baby Tee' is made from a soft cotton and modal-blend jersey. It features a crew neckline, a cropped hem, and a fitted, shrunken fit. This staple can be styled with jeans or track pants.

name: KREWE Zander Aviator Sunglasses
description: KREWE "Zander" aviator sunglasses feature an oversized silhouette. This unisex style is crafted in acetate with heavy beveling, gradient lenses, a keyhole nose bridge, and thin, tapered arms. It offers 100% UVA/UVB protection. The lens/bridge/temple dimensions are 52/21/148 in mm.

name: DÔEN henri ruffled pintucked lace blouse
description: The DÔEN ‘Henri' blouse is cut from delicate lace and has pintucked puffed sleeves and fluttery ruffles tracing the neckline. It is sheer.

name: Taekwondo Mei Ballet Leather Sneakers
description: adidas Originals first launched its ballet flats in the early 2000s, and these 'Taekwondo Mei' sneakers are a contemporary riff on the archival style. Made from contrasts of smooth leather, they're threaded with foot-framing laces and come with additional pairs in varying lengths so you can customize your look. They feature lace-up detailing.

name: Beige Half Slip Stretch Mini Skirt
Essentiel Antwerp Hilver Embellished Shirt
description: The Essentiel Antwerp Hilver shirt is crafted from cotton poplin and embellished with rhinestone and beaded details. This collared shirt features long sleeves with button cuffs, a button front, and a single chest patch pocket. It has a relaxed fit and a rounded hemline.

name: Janessa Leone Michon Packable Fedora
description: The Janessa Leone Michon fedora is crafted from paper and acrylic. It features a pinched crown, a flat, wide brim, and a dyed calf leather band. It offers UPF 35+ protection and can be spot cleaned. Made in USA.

name: Schutz Victorie Vinyl Dual-Band Slide Sandals
description: The Schutz Victorie sandals feature a clear vinyl upper, an open toe and a slide style. These mules have a cork block heel measuring 2.36 in / 60 mm. The outsole is made of leather and the lining is synthetic.

name: Hydrangea-Print Silk Organza Gown
description: This La Fuori gown features an allover hydrangea print, fitted bodice, and pleated skirt. This fit-and-flare silhouette has a strapless neckline, sleeveless design, drop waist, floor-sweeping hem, and a back zip. It is crafted of satin organza and polyester.

name: Cult Gaia Matias Cropped Embroidered Linen Top
description: This 'Matias' top from Cult Gaia features a cropped, cross-over design outlined in scalloped edges. It is crafted from breathable linen that is trimmed with mesh and has floral embroidery throughout.

name: Shoshanna Daniela Floral Lace Maxi Dress
description: The Shoshanna Daniela maxi dress is crafted of floral lace. This sleeveless dress features a jewel neckline, a pleated skirt and a high-low hem. It has an a-line silhouette, full length, and an invisible back zipper. Approximately 55.5"L from shoulders to hem.

name: Givenchy Marshmallow Wedge Slide Sandals
description: Givenchy 'Marshmallow' slide sandals are crafted of molded rubber with an open toe and a wide band upper. They feature a molded footbed and rubber outsole. The wedge heel measures approximately 4.50 inches / 115 mm with a 1.75 inches / 45 mm platform. Made in Italy.
